canvasAndScale.proposal: One common 1024-square RGBA source cell per drawing; shared call-wide scale and torso station; full wing envelopes inside padding
canvasAndScale.exportProposal: One uniform nearest-neighbor source-to-output transform for the whole call, initially 96-square for continuity; adjust whole batch once only if wings cannot fit or normal-size reading fails
canvasAndScale.physicalScaleCaveat: Projected alpha box is not total biological length; compare equivalent bill-to-tail axes and species ratio. Do not fit each changing wing envelope independently

displayTimingProposal.coverageMeaning: Four distinct drawn wing phases sampled at display rate; this 7.5 cycles/s display loop is deliberately stylized and is not the bird's measured wingbeat rate
displayTimingProposal.gate: Inspect real-time and slow playback before acceptance; if four-state cadence reads as slow flapping, hold it and design a separately labelled blur composite/display treatment. Do not relabel a slow loop biologically accurate
displayTimingProposal.bodyTrajectoryChannel: Constant torso root for initial hover test; no mandatory periodic bob or jitter
